title: checkride configuration
description: Schema for checkride.config.json — add it only to deviate from the zero-config defaults.

$schema.description: URL of this JSON Schema, for editor validation and autocompletion.

extends.description: Preset(s) to inherit — a file path (./base.json) or package specifier (@acme/preset), or an array of them. Bases merge left-to-right and the local config wins over all; objects deep-merge, arrays and scalars replace (arrays are not concatenated).

timeout.description: Default per-check timeout in seconds. Unset, checks fall back to the built-in 600s cap; 0 here or on a check disables the cap.

checks.description: Per-slot configuration. A key that matches a catalogue slot (types, format, lint, struct, dead, test, docs, links, spell, mutation, security, publint, attw) configures that slot; any other key is a custom check that runs alongside the catalogue. Naming an opt-in slot (format, mutation, security, publint, attw) here also opts it into the default run.

slotConfig.description: How to fill a slot: an adapter name, false to disable it, an adapter with overrides, or a custom check.

oneOf.description: Adapter name that fills this slot, beating detection.

useConfig.description: Pick an adapter by name and override individual fields.

use.description: Adapter name to select from the registry.

customCheck.description: A bare command that needs no adapter.

detect.description: Marker files that gate a non-catalogue custom check: it runs only when at least one listed file exists, and is skipped otherwise. Ignored on an entry that fills a catalogue slot.

order.description: Where a non-catalogue custom check runs relative to the catalogue. Default 'last'.
